Positions and times of all our runners are given below:— 10, S.

Les Stokell won the individual race with Syd Ring third and Bert Footer fourth. Bert was running for our “ B ” team, otherwise we should have scored a hollow win in the team race but even so we still came out winners and Syd Ring also took 2nd prize in the individual handicap race.
The Club Marathon Championship was held over the Poly course from Windsor to Chiswick and our first man home was Syd Ring in 2 hrs. 53 mins. 56 secs.
Our first man home was Dick Tobin who had been troubled by cramp in the Upminster race and then followed Bert Smith and Syd Ring who came in together.

Newcomers to our team were Jim Ginty (one of our finest runners ever), Dan Patience and Syd Ring. Our hat-trick of wins was accomplished in 1936 and we were the first club to have three wins in a row, even though Birchfield could boast five wins in all.
